description: Defines the AppState class managing application state, configuration, and runtime behaviors for a macOS app, including voice wake features, remote configuration, and UI settings.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Manages application state, configuration, voice wake features, remote settings, and UI preferences for a macOS app.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes AppState, loads configuration, sets defaults, and starts config watcher.

methods.name: applyConfigFromDisk
methods.description: Loads and applies configuration from disk.

methods.name: applyConfigOverrides
methods.description: Overrides current settings with configuration from disk.

methods.name: updateRemoteTarget
methods.description: Updates remote SSH target string based on host and user info.

methods.name: syncGatewayConfigNow
methods.description: Synchronizes current app config with gateway config if needed.

methods.name: triggerVoiceEars
methods.description: Activates voice ears for a specified TTL.

methods.name: blinkOnce
methods.description: Increments blink tick for UI animation.

methods.name: setVoiceWakeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice wake feature, requesting permissions if needed.

methods.name: setTalkEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode, requesting permissions if needed.

methods.name: applyGlobalVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Sets global voice wake triggers and suppresses immediate sync.

methods.name: scheduleVoiceWakeGlobalSyncIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules a delayed sync of voice wake triggers to gateway.

methods.name: loadChime
methods.description: Loads a chime configuration from user defaults.

methods.name: storeChime
methods.description: Stores a chime configuration to user defaults.
